items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Danny and I used to get him and take him out with us... we used to take Erroll Garner around there to play for them.

ctx.x: What about the little kid, the little short kid from Pittsburgh, Erroll Garner?

Oh, well, let's don't even mention him. Do you know, when we used to play Pittsburgh's Stanley Theater, Danny and I used to get him and take him out with us.
